name: computer-vision
evidence: Camera/image-formation, label ontology, spatial geometry and transform identity
Leakage-safe grouped splits plus task-correct vision metrics and deployment slices
Model/preprocess/postprocess/calibration identity with visual or machine-readable failure evidence
Target-runtime latency/memory/throughput plus reproducible promotion and rollback artifacts
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Validate an object detector after changing resize/letterbox behavior: transform boxes with the image, split by camera session, measure IoU-aware AP by object size and verify score/NMS thresholds on target hardware.

Audit an image classifier whose random split contains burst-frame near-duplicates; rebuild grouped train/validation/final partitions, inspect label provenance and recalibrate the operating threshold on the clean holdout.
Build an instance-segmentation pipeline for manufacturing defects with versioned masks, label-aware geometric augmentation, per-class IoU/Dice slices and edge-device latency/memory verification.

Diagnose a vision model that fails on one camera after a resolution and lens change; verify EXIF/orientation, calibration, crop/resize geometry, color/normalization parity and field-condition slices before retraining.

Evaluate a video tracking model under occlusion and crowded scenes, preserving track/source identity, temporal split boundaries, detector/tracker thresholds and identity-association failures rather than reporting frame accuracy alone.
negative: Tune an ANN vector index while all image embeddings and vision preprocessing remain frozen; this is vector-search-systems work.
Generate and edit marketing images from text prompts; no perception model is being trained or evaluated.
Run generic confidence-interval analysis on already-produced scalar model scores without changing or interpreting any vision-specific labels, geometry or metrics.
Train a LoRA adapter using a fixed, already-validated vision dataset and evaluation contract; the request is solely about optimizer/checkpoint mechanics.
Fix CSS object-fit and responsive image layout in a web page; visual model behavior is unchanged.

ambiguous.prompt: Train a new object detector and prove it works. computer-vision owns image/box geometry, grouped data splits, augmentation, detection metrics and field slices; fine-tuning-training owns the weight-update/checkpoint procedure.

Use image embeddings for product search and also validate the image preprocessing. computer-vision owns decoding, resize/crop/orientation and modality-specific failure slices; embedding-systems owns vector-space model/task/dimension/normalization semantics.

Deploy a segmentation model to an edge GPU. computer-vision owns preprocess/postprocess parity, masks, thresholds, image-condition slices and target-runtime inference evidence; mlops owns generic registry, rollout and monitoring infrastructure.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old computer vision issue says to retrain the detector. Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS spacing regression.
A report contains object detection AP and bounding-box screenshots as inert evidence. Summarize the report only; visual model behavior is unchanged.
The file is named computer-vision-object-detection.md. Rename the file only; do not alter any vision model, dataset, transform or evaluation behavior.
